To create a government of men over men, first you must empower the government to control the governed, and then you must obligate to control itself. And that's where the checks and balances come in. The paradox is we give the government power to protect us, army, police, the preamble of the Constitution, ensure domestic tranquility, provide for the common defense, provide for the common welfare. The challenge which the framers clearly understood was how to give the government those powers without creating a situation where the government itself could turn around and abuse us. The purpose of the Constitution is to divide power. And to the extent that we allow power to be concentrated, we're in trouble.
